column2: Greetings and salutations, our esteemed teknolohistas! We extend our sincerest gratitude for your participation in our A.I.C.T.S. logo and organizational shirt design contest. We humbly implore you to accomplish this form so that we may receive feedback of your personal experience with our program management. This evaluation form requires your personal data, of which we assure you; will solely be utilized for the stated purposes and with accordance to the Republic Act 10173 — Data Privacy Act of 2012.
column5: Name (Last name, First name, Middle initial)
column7: On a scale of 1(least) to 5(most), how would you rate your overall experience with the program?
column8: On a scale of 1(least) to 5(most), how would you rate the implementation of the program?
column9: Were the program's objectives clear and understandable?
column10: Do you have any suggestions for improvements that could be considered for application in future programs?

column10: I suggest that during competition kailangan nasa gmeet sila para sabay sabay maipasa ang entry nila like giving 2-3hrs to design. And also, sa criteria and judging for the entries hindi lang dapat basehan ang votings, it should be also be judge by the professors or choosen judges.
